story_type: overdue fishermen found at sea, swimmer and basket hoists one by one, helmet camera
hook: Three fishermen were overdue. A helicopter found them.
narration: Three fishermen on a twenty-foot boat had been reported overdue.
A Jayhawk crew from Air Station Clearwater found them near Great Inagua, in the Bahamas.
The crew lowered a rescue swimmer into the water to help them.
The swimmer gets each person into the basket, and the flight mechanic hoists them up one at a time.
One, then two, then all three were inside the helicopter.
Then the swimmer rode the cable back up.
outcome: The three fishermen were safely transferred to Provo, Turks and Caicos Islands, with no medical concerns.
title: 3 overdue fishermen found off the Bahamas
description:
An Air Station Clearwater MH-60 Jayhawk crew lowers a rescue swimmer to three people aboard an overdue 20-foot fishing boat near Great Inagua, Bahamas, on March 4, 2022.
